_note: Recommended stat curves the Build planner can follow. The tracker simulates each guide from level 1 ('start', the new-game stats) to get the ideal stats at every level, then gives each level-up's point to the stat furthest behind that curve. A phase lasts until 'untilLevel' (null = to the end); its pattern repeats, and stats that reached their target are skipped.

guides.name: Physical: 2/2/1 to level 30, then Strength
guides.source: User-provided guide: physical builds put points in Strength, Vitality and Agility; a balanced 2/2/1 spread with Agility on levels that are multiples of 5 keeps you safe and accurate until stats hit around 30.
